lines.trans: Taste this appetizer, gentlemen.
Listen, this is wonderful caviar!
You can immediately sense that it is natural.
Yes, I only ever ate such caviar in Astrakhan.
In Moscow you rarely encounter such quality.
Yes, delicious, very delicious!
The head chef of this restaurant is a true master.
And the fresh bread goes with it perfectly.
We will definitely order another portion.
I am ready to come here every day.
Pass on our sincere gratitude to the chef.
This evening was a glorious success!

meanings.note: agrees in gender and case with the noun

examples.trans: I grew up in a communal flat.

meanings.en: to be felt, be sensed, be palpable

examples.trans: You can immediately sense the freshness.

examples.text: В Москве редко встретишь такое качество.
examples.trans: In Moscow you rarely find such quality.

meanings.note: красная икра = red (salmon) caviar, чёрная икра = black caviar

examples.trans: You can see it at once.

meanings.en: other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)

meanings.note: regularly, or as a general invitation: приходи!
на днях = in the next few days, or the other day

examples.trans: I'll call in the next few days.

meanings.en: to try, to taste (food or drink)

examples.trans: Try the tea with bread rings.

meanings.en: executive chef, head of a kitchen

examples.trans: The head chef developed a new menu.
She works as an executive chef in Moscow.

meanings.note: usually the short form: я готов (m), я готова (f)
the imperative 'слушай' starts a sentence, like 'look, ...'

examples.trans: I was born and grew up here.

передать.gloss: to pass on, to hand over

meanings.en: to pass on, to hand over, to give

examples.trans: Please pass on my regards to your mum.
There won't be any quality anyway.
The programme is on the website.
He is running for a second term.
I'll definitely buy you a tank.

meanings.note: not to be confused with есть 'there is' (from быть)

examples.trans: The waiter brought two portions of salad.

meanings.note: plural хлеба, stressed on the ending

examples.trans: The bread is on the table.

meanings.en: to turn out well, to succeed, to manage (impersonal + dative)

examples.trans: Pass on our sincere gratitude to the chef.
I'm sick of this communal flat.

meanings.en: to meet, to pick up (at a station)

examples.text: Меня никто не встретил на вокзале.
examples.trans: Nobody met me at the station.
I will meet you at the entrance.

examples.text: Слушай, Нина, это же тот самый ресторан!
examples.trans: Listen, Nina, this is that very restaurant!

examples.text: Мы рады видеть вас в нашем ресторане.
examples.trans: We are glad to see you in our restaurant.

подходить.gloss: to approach, to come up; to suit

meanings.note: очередь подходит = one's turn is coming up
это мне подходит = that suits me

examples.trans: Let's go, our turn in the queue is coming up.
The train is approaching the station.
I love our town very much.
I know this town really well!
